exposure: Cervical clamp technique (placing two atraumatic ring forceps to the anterior and posterior sides of the cervix)
outcome: Need for re-exploration for persistent hemorrhage
Postoperative Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) scores
cohort: Four patients who underwent emergency postpartum hysterectomy after vaginal delivery due to uncontrollable postpartum atony.
finding: The cervical clamp technique was successfully performed in four cases, preventing postoperative complications and re-exploration, and may facilitate total hysterectomy by clearly defining the cervicovaginal boundary.
